The '''Power Surge Vent''' was a safety device aboard [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation's]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]]. It was designed to vent the [[Engine/Legends|engine]] compartment of excess power output, fission byproduct, or cooling [[Gas/Legends|gasses]]. The Power Surge Vent included a [[5k c3 carbon/halon extinguisher system]] that was intended to shut the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter's]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]] in an emergency.<ref name="SWS" />
